Overview

The BLUETTI PV200 Solar Panel 200W is a 200 W monocrystalline solar panel with 23.4% cell efficiency. It suits Kenyan homes and trips that want free daytime charging for a power station, and cuts how often you need KPLC power to recharge.

Read moreShow less

In full sun it produces up to 200 W; real output is lower in cloud, heat and shade, so plan with some margin. Pair it with a power station whose solar input accepts at least 200 W, angle it towards the midday sun and keep the surface clean for the best output.

It connects with MC4. Browse our power stations to find one that matches.

Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W — Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from Kenyan buyers. Still unsure? Ask us on WhatsApp.

How much is the Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W in Kenya?

The Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W costs KES 26,000 at Batteriq, Kenya's authorised BLUETTI dealer. You can pay instantly with M-Pesa or by Visa/Mastercard at checkout. It is covered by a 24-month warranty.

Is the Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W available in Nairobi?

Yes — the Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W is in stock and ready to ship. We deliver across Nairobi and ship nationwide to all 47 counties, and you will get an official eTIMS KRA invoice with your order.

Does the Bluetti PV200 Solar Panel 200W work with my power station?

It connects to compatible EcoFlow and BLUETTI power stations for solar charging. Send us your power station model on WhatsApp and we will confirm the right cable and setup before you buy. It is covered by a 24-month warranty.

What can the BLUETTI PV200 Solar Panel 200W run in a Kenyan home?

A solar panel charges a power station rather than running appliances directly. In full sun the BLUETTI PV200 Solar Panel 200W produces up to 200 W, which tops up a power station during the day so it can run your lights, Wi-Fi, TV and fridge through a KPLC outage.

Which power stations work with the BLUETTI PV200 Solar Panel 200W?

Any power station whose solar input accepts at least 200 W and the MC4 connector can use it. Message us on WhatsApp with your model and we will confirm the right cable.
